 Unifree Duty Free taps rising K-beauty demand with dedicated concept at Istanbul Airport
 by Camille Bersola | 
 12 November 2026 
 | camille@moodiedavittreport.com Share:
 K-beauty’s global rise has earned it a dedicated place in the beauty retail landscape at Istanbul Airport through lead travel retailer Unifree Duty Free TÜRKIYE. Unifree Duty Free has opened a dedicated K-beauty space at Istanbul Airport, bringing together popular Korean skincare brands in a showcase supported by a month-long experiential activation in October.
 The initiative reflects the retailer’s focus on introducing global beauty trends and creating engaging experiences for travellers, tapping into what the company described as one of the world’s most dynamic and influential beauty categories.
 Designed in soft pink tones, the contemporary space spotlights K-beauty brands, including Laneige, Anua and COSRX.
 Adding to the appeal of the new space, the October activation featured special K-pop dance performances inspired by Korean popular culture, bringing an entertainment-led element to the terminal and engaging passengers beyond the traditional shopping experience.
 Bringing the K-pop vibe to the terminal: Special dance performances set to popular Korean music added an energetic twist to the K-beauty launch, capturing passengers’ attention and encouraging them to explore the skincare showcase Driven by innovation, ingredient-focused formulations and a skincare-first philosophy, K-beauty has gained a strong following among younger consumers globally. Unifree Duty Free aims to tap into this growing demand while broadening its appeal across its international passenger base.
 The initiative forms part of Unifree Duty Free’s broader efforts to diversify its retail offer and bring emerging global trends to Istanbul Airport. The retailer noted its plans to further strengthen its brand assortment in response to growing demand for K-beauty.
 Unifree Duty Free Chief Commercial Officer Ceren Tonguç said: “At Unifree Duty Free, we continuously evolve our retail offering in line with emerging consumer trends and the expectations of our diverse international passenger base.
 “The launch of our dedicated K-Beauty area reflects the growing global appeal of Korean beauty brands and our commitment to bringing the most relevant and sought-after concepts to Istanbul Airport.
 “By combining a curated brand selection featuring Laneige, Anua and COSRX with engaging cultural elements such as K-Pop performances, we have created a destination that goes beyond traditional retail.
 “This initiative is part of our broader strategy to deliver innovative, experience-driven shopping environments that enhance the passenger journey and strengthen Istanbul Airport’s position as a leading global travel retail hub.” ✈
